note: *o carente*, applied by the review under D38 after *indigente* failed its fourth blind reader here. This psalm's agent proposed *desvalido*, the option (HANDOFF 17).
*sustenta os justos*: *confirma* was heard as "attests". The final Latinist minor says *sustenta* drifts and asks *fortalece*, which is *confortári*'s word; option 3.
*será abençoada*, held against the same Latinist minor on three drafts asking *estará em bênção*, which is not current Portuguese. *estará na bênção* is option 2.
*muito exaltado*: *sumamente* was unknown to the blind reader. The same choice is open in canticles 210 and 220 (HANDOFF 24): *sumamente* or *muito*.
